title: Container with Most Water
kidExplanation: Vertical sticks in a row. Choose two sticks as walls; rainwater forms a rectangle. Maximize the water.
plainProblem: LeetCode 11: Container with Most Water. Restate the official prompt in your own words, list inputs and outputs, then solve a tiny example by hand before coding.

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the loops. If work looks like n×n, say so. Google interviewers want that honesty.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To find the maximum area of water that can be held between two vertical lines, we can use a two-pointer approach. We initialize two pointers, one at the beginning of the input array (left) and the other at the end of the array (right). The area between the two vertical lines is calculated as the minimum of the heights at the two pointers multiplied by the distance between them. We then update the maximum area found so far and move the pointer with the smaller height towards the other pointer. We continue this process until the two pointers meet or cross each other.
